source.title: On simple groups that admit a string C-group representation
source.edition: Bound six-page author manuscript with placeholder journal dates; no inferred final publication date

read_scope: Entire six-page primary text and all six page rasters read; both named theorems and all finite/parameter branches covered.
literal_qualification: The center/axis commutation equivalence requires distinct projectivities. The rank-four proof is replaced without claiming the principal theorem false.

source_listing_inventory.source_mentions: Magma, Section 4; no executable file supplied

dispositions.statement: Same principal list as Theorem 1.1.
Involutory generation, string commutation, and every subset intersection.
Automorphism groups of abstract regular polytopes correspond to string C-groups.
dispositions.complete_route: Classical correspondence, not used to exclude group markings

dispositions.statement: For nonabelian finite simple groups, an involutory generating triple with commuting endpoints has IP.
Every nonabelian finite simple group outside the listed exceptions is generated by three involutions with two commuting.
Complete all-rank classification with the four infinite families and eight finite exclusions.
dispositions.complete_route: A.classification; complete U; all eight required finite cases

dispositions.statement: Irreducible projective degree-three C-group implies odd characteristic, a nondegenerate form lift, and rank at most four.
A projective involution has the specified canonical linear involution lift.
Commuting center/axis criterion for projective involutions.
dispositions.complete_route: U equation (1): distinct projectivities required; self-commutation is excluded from this equivalence

dispositions.statement: Characteristic-two degree-three case referred to Brooksbank–Vicinsky.
Uniqueness of an involution commuting with the first noncommuting pair gives the rank bound.
Three-dimensional and four-dimensional form spaces intersect, with radical excluded by irreducibility.
Rank-four invariant symmetric form.
dispositions.complete_route: U.three rank-four paragraph: three diagonal entries satisfy two homogeneous equations; no presumed irreducibility of first three-generator subgroup

dispositions.statement: Every nonabelian simple PSL3(q) is excluded in all ranks.
Every nonabelian simple PSU3(q) is excluded in all ranks.
PSL4(2^n), n>=1, has no string C-group representation.
PSU4(2^n), n>=1, has no string C-group representation.
dispositions.complete_route: U.support + U.six + U.four; both signs proved uniformly

dispositions.statement: PSU4(3) has no string C-group marking of any rank; permutation degree 280.
PSU5(2) has no string C-group marking of any rank; permutation degree 165.

A7 has no string C-group marking of any rank; permutation degree 7.

M22 has no string C-group marking of any rank; permutation degree 22.
M23 has no string C-group marking of any rank; permutation degree 23.
McL has no string C-group marking of any rank; permutation degree 275.
